instruction: In src/ledger/large.py, clip_entry leaves stray tabs, newlines, dashes, underscores or dots on entry text. Make it treat text built only from whitespace, dashes, underscores and dots as fully trimmed.
check:
import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(root, 'src'))
from ledger.large import clip_entry
assert clip_entry('  x  ') == 'x'
assert clip_entry('-_-.x..-_') == 'x'
assert clip_entry('\t\n-.x. -\n') == 'x'
ok = True
